critical_code_review_comments: BackupRestoreModal.jsx handleExport (L28-59) and handleFilePick (L61-89) both correctly place the auth gate BEFORE any side-effect (exportAllData, file.text, JSON.parse, setPendingPayload). Pattern is byte-identical to NotesApp.handleBackup / handleClearAllData — good code hygiene.
handleFilePick's try/finally correctly resets fileInputRef.current.value = '' on ALL exit paths (auth-fail, JSON-parse-error, wrong app tag, success). Verified live.
Markdown export/import handlers remain intentionally ungated — matches the spec and iteration_83 scope limit. Consider documenting this as a follow-up repair.
SecurityService.verifyBiometric returns !!assertion — my stub returned a truthy object and it resolved as expected. No changes needed.
